raw_text: ALERT: Pakistan ISPR has released a deepfake video of an alleged IAF pilot. Multiple forensic analysts have already confirmed this is AI-generated. The video shows clear lip-sync anomalies and the uniform insignia does not match current IAF regulations. This appears to be a coordinated information operation targeting Indian elections. The video was simultaneously pushed across Twitter, YouTube, and WhatsApp groups in Pakistan. Indian fact-checking organisations including AltNews and BoomLive have flagged this as synthetic media. Share this warning to counter the disinformation campaign.
